metadata.title: Security Operations

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for monitoring, detecting, investigating, and responding to security events.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Security operations, monitoring, detection, and response technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern for end-to-end security operations and incident handling capability.

metadata.remarks: Security Operations is a composite pattern asserting that the institution has effective capabilities to observe security-relevant activity, detect and validate threats, respond to incidents, and conduct forensic investigation. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be claimed only when all constituent security operations patterns are realized.

components.title: Logging and Telemetry
components.description: Generation, collection, and protection of security-relevant logs and telemetry.

components.title: Security Monitoring
components.description: Continuous analysis and correlation of telemetry for situational awareness.

components.title: Threat Detection
components.description: Identification, confirmation, and prioritization of malicious activity.

components.title: Incident Response
components.description: Coordination and execution of response actions for confirmed security incidents.

components.title: Digital Forensics
components.description: Preservation and analysis of evidence to support investigation and accountability.
